thread:
elaine: FYI - Enterprise customer asked for provable audit exports: 8+ year retention, exportable signed bundles auditors can verify offline. Any existing plan?
hiro: No current GA feature. We can offer time-bound archives + a manifest that includes checksums and signature metadata.
mike: What level of verification do they need? Full WORM storage or cryptographic proof that exported snapshot equals stored records? Big difference.
elaine: They said "cryptographic proof" and "non-repudiable export". Prefer BYOK but asked if we can support Redwood-signed bundles as fallback.
legal-bot: legal: contracts must define key custody, rotation policy, and dispute resolution for mismatches. Auditors generally accept signed manifests + attestation.
sam: Ops note: cheapest path = cold blob with daily NDJSON snapshots. On-request, assemble bundle, run checksum, sign manifest, provide tarball + manifest.json.
infra-bot: retention-service: queued snapshot job (id=rs-1798765439-01)
mike: Prototype manifest example for discussion:

```
{
  "snapshot_id": "rs-1798765439-01",
  "created_at": "2026-06-10T15:10:00Z",
  "records_count": 121234,
  "bundle_sha256": "<hex>",
  "signer": "projects/123/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/k1",
  "signature": "<base64>",
  "schema_version": "v1",
  "redaction": "pii-masked",
  "verification_cli": "redwood-verify v0.1"
}
```

hiro: Important ACs to capture: signer identity (customer KMS id or Redwood HSM id), timestamping, redaction applied before signing, verification tooling, and SLA for export generation.
elaine: Product: propose an "Archival Evidence" addon SKU: storage-per-GB/month + per-export fee + optional BYOK attestation fee. Sales wants a templated offer for their POC customer.
legal-bot: Also require a notarization paragraph: if Redwood-signed, include HSM attestation statement; if BYOK, include handshake proof and key fingerprint in contract.
sam: Engineering questions: streaming sign vs sign-after-assemble, support for partial/continuation exports, and whether we store signed manifests alongside cold blobs or only hand them to customer.
mike: UX: admin console list of snapshots, preview (sample rows + checksum), and "Finalize & Sign" button. Preview must be auditable (checksum commitment) before final sign.
hiro: Security: if BYOK, we need proof customer controls private key (e.g., sign a challenge). Also policy for key rotation - signed archives must indicate key version and rotation epoch.
elaine: Action items: 1) Product to draft PRD with ACs and pricing draft; 2) Infra to estimate storage + export CPU/e2e time; 3) Security to design BYOK handshake and HSM attestation text; 4) Legal to draft contract clauses for export verification and liability; 5) Devex to prepare verification CLI and quickstart.
sam: I'll run a cost delta (archive vs searchable index) and post estimates tomorrow.
mike: I'll sketch the manifest schema + CLI commands this week.
legal-bot: I'll loop in external assessor for SOC2/ISO confirmation on the proof model.
elaine: Cool. Tell sales we'll respond with a formal offer by EOW. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
